board.snap.description: Shapes moved, resized or drawn on a planning board snap to the edges and centers of the elements on the screen, and a moved selection to equal gaps between its neighbours, with guides showing what lined up. Hold Alt while dragging to place freely; the toolbar's magnet turns it off and on.

board.ai.model.description: The model a planning board's chats run on when they name none: a profile of ai.models, or a version Claude Code offers (claude-opus-4-8). Empty: the default chain (ai.defaultModel). Settings > AI > Defaults sets every use's (docs/04 Defaults by use).

board.ai.effort.description: The effort a planning board's chats run at when they name none: low, medium, high, xhigh or max. Empty: the model's own (Claude Code says what it is for each model).
